When Crypto Stopped Diversifying: The ETF Regime Shift
Can crypto still help diversify an equity portfolio—or has that edge disappeared? That’s the practical question behind Crypto Contagion. The paper looks at how shocks move between crypto and U.S. equities, and more importantly, how that relationship changed after the launch of crypto ETFs. Instead of relying on simple correlations, the authors use a combination of jump detection (to isolate real stress events) and machine learning techniques to identify actual spillovers.
